scope: synthetic single-user backend workload; no UI, customer, or business-value claim

measurement.execution: run_project complete candidate/commit transition; ingestion and setup recorded separately
measurement.export: export_project plus typed archive serialization/compression; archive write recorded separately
measurement.reopen: fresh process backend imports plus archive read, loads_project and validate_project
measurement.rss: OS whole-process high-water mark including imports and oracle checks, maximum across execution and reopen processes
measurement.percentile: nearest-rank p95 of measured samples; warm-up excluded from timing percentile

declared_environment.scope: Performance measurements use actual installed packages; matching declared dependencies is a separate release gate.
